title: Separate values overlays and init concurrency profiles for private installer
author: Priya Agarwal
description: Introduce a structured overlay mechanism for environment-specific values plus a first-class init.concurrencyProfiles schema to control init-job concurrency, priority, and backoff behavior. Motivation: previous single-values layout made airgap/enterprise/custom overlays ad-hoc and required template forks; init job concurrency was a single numeric field which made it hard to express different profiles for seeding, migrations, and tenant bootstrap. This change adds: 1) values.overlays: a top-level map that allows named overlays (cloud, airgap, onprem-edge) to be merged at render time; 2) init.concurrencyProfiles: named profiles with fields {batchSize,poolSelector,priorityClass,parallelismPolicy,backoffSeconds,maxRetries} and a new defaultProfile pointer; 3) Helm helper templates for overlay lookup and safe merge semantics; 4) schema validation and unit tests for values.schema.json; 5) documentation and upgrade notes for operators including an automated migrator that converts legacy init.concurrency -> init.concurrencyProfiles.default.batchSize when present. The PR includes test manifests for both k8s and airgapped environments, example overlay files, and a short compatibility shim to keep existing installs working. This description contains a short checklist and rollout steps: CHECKLIST: 1) values.schema.json updated; 2) helm helpers added under templates/_helpers.tpl; 3) integration tests for private-installer CI; 4) migration script packaged into chart's helm hooks as optional pre-upgrade job; 5) docs updated under docs/installer/overlays.md; ROLLOUT: staged canary on a non-prod tenant pool, monitor init job latency/throughput for 48 hours, then bump release to all tenants. Linear: ENG-2104; Related: ENG-2120. Breaking changes: none for existing installs when migration script runs; operators who rely on custom templating may need to audit overlays.

review_comments: Ethan Moore: Please add a note in the upgrade docs about the optional pre-upgrade hook being idempotent; I hit a double-run in a dry-run cluster and want assurance it is safe to skip.

Priya Agarwal (author): Added explicit idempotency markers to the migrator and documented how to opt-out by setting migration.enabled=false. See templates/init-migrator-job.yaml for the marker and docs/installer/overlays.md for opt-out instructions.

Lina Rodriguez: The values.schema.json addition looks good but we should limit priorityClass to existing cluster values instead of free string. Suggest enumerating common classes or allowing a reference pattern.
Priya Agarwal (author): Updated schema to allow either a direct name or a reference object {type: 'k8s', name: '<class>'}; added examples and a runtime validation note in the README.
Samir Patel: Could you add a CI test that renders overlays for an airgap profile? We should prevent regressions where overlay merge loses secrets section.
Priya Agarwal (author): Added tests/render_overlays_test.go that exercises cloud, airgap, and onprem-edge overlays and asserts secrets remain under sealedSecrets key; CI green after change.
release_notes: Introduce values.overlays for environment-specific value merging and init.concurrencyProfiles to define named init-job concurrency and priority behaviors. Includes migration shim for legacy init.concurrency. No breaking changes expected for default installs. Operators with custom overlay templates should validate post-upgrade.
